question: Related Questions Q. I pay zakat ever year and like to pick one or two families who can benefit the most from it. However, as it happens, the zakat fulfills their temporary needs. They spend money quickly and are again in need (for example widows, children, etc). Many do not know how to make good use of money (to start a small business, open a shop, etc). 1. Can I invest the money (amount of annual zakat) on behalf of the needy and pay them the profit (they remain the owners of capital and can take it from me anytime)? 2. My father runs a trust. The trust makes investments in businesses and the profits are used for charity purposes. Can I pay my zakat to his trust? Can the trust invest my zakat and pay the profit in charity? 3. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 16017 Country: AF Title: Zakah on the price of truck Question: Dear Mufti Sahib. Asalamulik. Amabad. my elder brother has one dump truck which costs around 50,000 US Dollars. he is also the driver of the same truck, he drives this truck to take care of his family. all the money that he makes is not more than his family expenses. I mean the profit of this Truck is not more than his expenses. now should he give Zakat of the Truck? I told you the truck cost 50,000 Dollars now if he needs to pay Zakat he will need to pay 1250 dollars but he does not have that amount, then he will need to sell his truck to pay Zakat. please let me know. he really really needs to know soon. our native language is Pashto, and I am writing from Kandahar Afghanistan, my brother does not speak or write urdu or English, that is why he wants me to aks you his question, your quick answer will be highly appreciated. Sincerely Ahmadullah Ahmadi From kandahar-Afghanistan 22 Aug 09 Answer ID: 16017 Posted on: Apr 27, 2024 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1477/1479/M=1430) There is no Zakah on the price of the truck, so there is no need to give Zakah by selling it. And, in the case mentioned above, there is no Zakah on its profits as well. Yes, if you save some money from family expenses which is equal to nisab, you will have to pay its Zakah after completion of one lunar year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
